steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: This is Estimates. Every estimate across your company is in this one list.

steps.caption: Number, client, title, status, total
steps.narration: Each row shows the number, the client, the title, the status and the total.

steps.caption: Tick Approved
steps.narration: To narrow the list, tick a status. Approved shows the ones your clients have accepted.

steps.caption: 3 of 6
steps.narration: The count shows how many match: three of six.

steps.caption: Add Sent
steps.narration: Tick a second status to add it. Now the list has Approved and Sent.

steps.caption: Sort
steps.narration: Sort puts the newest, the oldest or the largest estimates first.

steps.caption: Date range
steps.narration: The date lists keep only today, the last seven days, the last thirty, or a range you choose.

steps.caption: Search
steps.narration: Or search by estimate number or client name.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: Click the number to open the estimate.

steps.caption: Sent, opened, valid until
steps.narration: This line shows when it was sent, whether the client has opened it, and how long it's valid.

steps.caption: Back to the list
steps.narration: Estimates takes you back to the list.

steps.caption: Menu: Estimates
steps.narration: You'll find Estimates in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find and filter estimates | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Estimates list in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will filter by status, sort, narrow by date, search by number or client name, and open an estimate to see when it was sent and whether the client has opened it.
